negative.name: receipt_byte_tamper
negative.operation: For every byte offset in receipt_hex, xor the byte with 0x01 and require rejection (either malformed magic/type or authentication failure).

negative.name: wrong_confirming_device
negative.operation: Verify receipt_hex against a principal other than confirming_device_principal_hex and require authentication failure.

negative.name: truncated_receipt
negative.operation: Remove the last byte of receipt_hex (236 bytes) and require rejection as malformed.

negative.name: oversized_receipt
negative.operation: Append one extra 0x00 byte to receipt_hex (238 bytes) and require rejection as malformed.

negative.name: wrong_receipt_type
negative.operation: Replace byte offset 4 (the receipt type, 0x01) with 0xff and require rejection as malformed.

negative.name: wrong_confirmed_object
negative.operation: Verify with an expected confirmed object whose message identifier differs from confirmed_message_id_hex; the signature still verifies under confirming_device_principal_hex, but the caller MUST reject it as an object mismatch, not treat the signature check alone as sufficient.
